data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,031k in the year, predominantly in respect of Property and Accident & Health business (2015: GBP 3,679k, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business).
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2016 was GBP 48.51m. During 2016 there was a gross release in prior year provisions of GBP 12.891m (a c.26.6% release relative to opening gross reserves). The Managing Agent reports a positive run-off deviation (net) in the year of GBP 3.031m, predominantly in Property and Accident & Health, indicating favourable claims development was the primary driver of prior year reserve movement. Some parts of the business experienced catastrophe and large loss activity in the year, but overall prior year development was a release on the gross technical provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: positive run off deviation of GBP 3,031k in the year
The claims experience in 2016 reflects an increase in the level of catastrophe losses over the previous year
a small number of large risk losses
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the gross 'Change in prior year provisions' are taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (page 36) (values in GBP 000). The report also quotes a net 'positive run off deviation' of GBP 3,031k (verbatim) which is a net (after reinsurance) figure and differs from the gross movement; gross movement used here per instructions. A net claims development triangle is provided (page 35) and has been extracted; gross triangle presence is indicated in the report but the clearer readily-extractable table in the PDF images was net. No specific named catastrophe events are listed in the text provided. Some LOB-level reserve movements are described narratively (Property and Accident & Health) but not quantified on a gross basis, so LOB amounts are null.
